name: Dranik Hollows: South
summary: A war‑scarred cavern front where Muramite forces push toward the Catacombs and Discord ruptures destabilize the terrain.
description: Hollows South is the most war‑torn and corrupted section of the Dranik Hollows. Muramite forces use the southern caverns as a forward assault route toward the Dranik Catacombs. Discord ruptures tear through the stone, creating unstable terrain and arcane hazards. Dragorn resistance fighters maintain hidden fallback positions, but the area is heavily contested. The caverns echo with battle, collapsing stone, and the hum of Discord energy.
